repos.description: An AI skill that provides design intelligence for building professional UI/UX across multiple platforms.
repos.summary_zh: UI UX Pro Max 是一款 AI 技能，专为多平台构建专业 UI/UX 设计而生。其核心功能是通过 AI 驱动的设计系统生成器，快速分析项目需求并输出适配不同框架的完整设计体系，支持 67 种 UI 风格与 100 条推理规则，显著提升跨平台设计效率与一致性。
repos.summary_en: UI UX Pro Max is an AI skill delivering intelligent design solutions for professional UI/UX across multiple platforms. Its flagship Design System Generator uses AI reasoning to instantly analyze project requirements and generate tailored, framework-agnostic design systems, supporting 67 UI styles and 100 reasoning rules for efficient cross-platform design.

repos.description: An enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design 是蚂蚁集团开源的企业级 UI 设计语言和 React 组件库，提供高质量、可复用的前端组件与完整的设计系统。支持 TypeScript、主题定制、国际化及 SSR，适用于中后台管理系统开发，具备完善的开发工具链和丰富的设计资源。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design is an enterprise-class UI design language and React UI library developed by Ant Group, offering a comprehensive set of high-quality, customizable components and design resources. Built with TypeScript, it supports internationalization, theme customization, SSR, and modern tooling for efficient enterprise application development.

repos.description: Material UI: Comprehensive React component library that implements Google's Material Design. Free forever.
repos.summary_zh: Material UI 是一个基于 Google Material Design 的 React 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和主题系统，支持无障碍访问和响应式设计。它经过十年开源社区验证，稳定可靠，适合构建现代化 Web 应用，并通过 MUI X 扩展高级组件功能。
repos.summary_en: Material UI is a comprehensive React component library implementing Google's Material Design. It offers battle-tested, accessible, and responsive UI components with a customizable theme system. Trusted by global product teams, it extends functionality via MUI X for advanced use cases.

repos.description: :tada: A magical vue admin                                                                https://panjiachen.github.io/vue-element-admin
repos.summary_zh: vue-element-admin 是一个基于 Vue 2.6+ 和 Element UI 2.7+ 的现代化企业级后台管理系统解决方案，提供国际化支持、权限管理、数据可视化等完整功能，支持快速搭建复杂单页应用，适用于中大型管理后台开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-element-admin is a production-ready front-end solution for admin interfaces built on Vue 2.6+ and Element UI 2.7+. It features i18n support, role-based permissions, dashboard widgets, and enterprise-grade templates to accelerate development of complex single-page applications.

repos.description: Drop in a screenshot and convert it to clean code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue)
repos.summary_zh: screenshot-to-code 是一款 AI 驱动的工具，支持将截图、设计稿或 Figma 设计直接转换为高质量的前端代码（HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue），支持 Gemini 3、Claude Opus 4.5 等先进模型，提供实验性视频录制转代码功能，适用于快速原型开发和 UI 自动化生成。
repos.summary_en: screenshot-to-code is an AI-powered tool that converts screenshots, mockups, and Figma designs into clean, functional front-end code (HTML/Tailwind/React/Vue). It supports advanced models like Gemini 3 and Claude Opus 4.5, with experimental video-to-code capabilities for rapid prototyping and UI automation.

repos.description: An awesome list that curates the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, articles and more.
repos.summary_zh: Solido/awesome-flutter 是一个精选的 Flutter 资源库，涵盖最佳库、工具、教程、文章等，为开发者提供全面的 Flutter 开发指南，助力跨平台应用开发。
repos.summary_en: Solido/awesome-flutter is a curated list of the best Flutter libraries, tools, tutorials, and articles, serving as a comprehensive resource for Flutter developers to build cross-platform applications.

repos.description: A Vue.js 2.0 UI Toolkit for Web
repos.summary_zh: Element 是一个基于 Vue.js 2.0 的企业级 UI 组件库，提供丰富的组件和完善的文档支持，适用于中后台管理系统开发。采用模块化设计，支持主题定制，具备完善的国际化方案，并拥有活跃的社区生态。
repos.summary_en: Element is a Vue.js 2.0 UI toolkit for web development, offering a comprehensive set of components and documentation for enterprise-level applications. It features modular architecture, theme customization, full internationalization, and an active community ecosystem.

repos.description: Semantic is a UI component framework based around useful principles from natural language.
repos.summary_zh: Semantic UI 是一个基于自然语言原则的现代化 UI 组件框架，提供 50+ 组件、3000+ CSS 变量和三级变量继承体系，支持 EM 响应式设计和 Flexbox 布局，兼容 React/Angular 等主流框架，助力快速构建美观且可维护的前端界面。
repos.summary_en: Semantic UI is a modern UI component framework based on natural language principles, offering 50+ components, 3000+ CSS variables, and a three-level variable inheritance system. It supports responsive design with EM values and Flexbox, integrates seamlessly with React, Angular, and other frameworks, enabling rapid development of beautiful and maintainable web interfaces.

repos.description: Reverse Engineering / Authorized Penetration Testing / Security Research Skill Router Pack AI-powered routing + On-demand toolchain bootstrapping + Self-evolving knowledge base  Supports Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline, and other AI coding clients 逆向/渗透/安全技能路由包 - AI 自动路由 + 按需自举工具链 + 自动进化经验库 | 支持 Claude Code / Kiro / Cursor / Cline 等代码 AI 客户端
repos.summary_zh: 面向逆向工程、授权渗透测试与安全研究的 AI 技能路由包，提供智能任务分发、按需工具链自举与自进化经验库，支持 Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali 多平台，兼容 Claude Code、Kiro、Cursor、Cline 等主流 AI 编程客户端。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered skill router for reverse engineering, authorized penetration testing, and security research. It provides intelligent task routing, on-demand toolchain bootstrapping, and a self-evolving knowledge base across Windows/Linux/macOS/Kali, compatible with Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Cline and other AI coding clients.

repos.description: Materialize, a CSS Framework based on Material Design
repos.summary_zh: MaterializeCSS 是基于 Material Design 原则构建的现代化 CSS 框架，提供丰富的预构建组件（如导航栏、卡片、表单）和流畅的动画效果，支持响应式布局与主流浏览器兼容，适用于快速开发美观且用户友好的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: MaterializeCSS is a modern CSS framework based on Material Design principles, offering a rich set of pre-built components (e.g., navigation, cards, forms) with smooth animations and responsive layouts, compatible with major browsers for rapid development of visually appealing and user-friendly web applications.

repos.description: Clone any website with one command using AI coding agents
repos.summary_zh: AI网站克隆模板通过Claude Code实现网页逆向工程，利用Chrome MCP自动提取设计元素与组件规格，并行构建像素级复刻站点。支持多页面、响应式交互还原及资产下载，基于Next.js 16+shadcn/ui技术栈，提供自动化开发流水线。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered website cloning template that reverse-engineers any site using Claude Code and Chrome MCP. It extracts design tokens, generates component specs, and rebuilds pages pixel-perfect via parallel builder agents in isolated git worktrees. Built with Next.js 16, shadcn/ui, and Tailwind CSS v4.

repos.description: Documentation that simply works
repos.summary_zh: Material for MkDocs 是一个基于 MkDocs 的强大文档框架，支持 Markdown 编写，可快速生成专业、可搜索、多语言（60+）且跨设备的静态网站。提供高度定制化主题与现代化界面，适用于开源和商业项目文档。
repos.summary_en: Material for MkDocs is a powerful documentation framework built on top of MkDocs, enabling fast creation of professional, searchable, multilingual (60+), and device-agnostic static sites from Markdown. It offers a customizable Material Design theme ideal for open-source and commercial projects.

repos.description: A UI library by WeChat official design team, includes the most useful widgets/modules in mobile web applications.
repos.summary_zh: WeUI 是腾讯微信官方设计团队打造的开源 UI 库，专为微信小程序和 Web 应用设计，提供丰富的移动端组件（如按钮、表单、弹窗等），确保与微信生态一致的用户体验，支持快速构建美观、标准化的移动 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: WeUI is an open-source UI library developed by Tencent's WeChat design team, specifically tailored for WeChat web and mini-program development. It offers a comprehensive set of mobile-first components (e.g., buttons, forms, dialogs) to deliver a consistent and standardized user experience across WeChat ecosystems, enabling rapid development of visually appealing mobile web apps.

repos.description: The Developer Tool for Visual Engineers • An Open-Source AI-First Design tool • Visually build, style, and edit your code with AI • World's best, top-most agent recommended #1 Developer tool for Designers and Visual Engineers to design with Real Code.
repos.summary_zh: Onlook 是一款面向设计师的开源 AI 驱动可视化代码编辑器，支持在浏览器中实时编辑 React 应用。它结合 Next.js 和 TailwindCSS，提供类 Figma 的 UI 设计体验，实现视觉化开发、实时预览、组件管理和一键部署，是 Bolt.new 等工具的替代方案。
repos.summary_en: Onlook is an open-source, AI-first visual code editor for designers, enabling real-time React app editing in the browser. Built with Next.js and TailwindCSS, it offers a Figma-like interface for visual development, component management, and instant deployment, serving as an alternative to tools like Bolt.new.

repos.description: Bootstrap 5 & Material Design UI KIT
repos.summary_zh: MDBootstrap 提供基于 Bootstrap 5 和 Material Design 的免费 UI 组件库，包含 700+ 原生 JavaScript 组件，支持 npm、CDN 和 Webpack 集成，适用于快速构建现代化网页界面，被 NASA、Nike 等企业广泛使用。
repos.summary_en: MDBootstrap offers a free UI kit with 700+ Bootstrap 5 components based on Material Design, built in plain JavaScript. It supports npm, CDN, and Webpack integration, enabling rapid development of modern web interfaces trusted by 3M+ developers and enterprises like NASA and Nike.

repos.description: A high quality UI Toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0
repos.summary_zh: iView 是基于 Vue.js 2.0 开发的高质量 UI 组件库，提供数十个美观实用的组件，支持 Vue 1.x 和 2.x、SSR、TypeScript、Electron 等，适用于企业级应用开发，文档详尽且提供丰富示例。
repos.summary_en: iView is a high-quality UI toolkit built on Vue.js 2.0, offering dozens of beautiful and practical components. It supports Vue 1.x/2.x, SSR, TypeScript, Electron, and provides extensive documentation with demos for enterprise-level applications.

repos.description: flutter 开发者帮助 APP，包含 flutter 常用 140+ 组件的demo 演示与中文文档
repos.summary_zh: FlutterGo 是阿里巴巴推出的 Flutter 开发者辅助应用，提供 140+ 组件的中文文档与演示，帮助开发者快速掌握 Flutter 开发。因团队调整暂停维护，但计划未来迭代并招募社区贡献者。
repos.summary_en: FlutterGo is an Alibaba-developed Flutter developer helper app featuring 140+ component demos and Chinese documentation. It aids developers in mastering Flutter. Due to internal restructuring, maintenance is temporarily paused, with plans for future updates and community contributions.

repos.description: 全面ESM+Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript编写的一款后台管理系统（兼容移动端）
repos.summary_zh: vue-pure-admin 是一款基于 ESM 规范的现代化中后台管理系统模板，采用 Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript 技术栈构建，支持移动端适配。提供完整的前端架构与组件库，包含国际化精简版本，打包体积优化至350KB以下，配套详细文档与视频教程，支持 Docker 部署与 Gitpod 在线开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-pure-admin is a modern admin template built with ESM standard, using Vue3+Vite+Element-Plus+TypeScript stack. It supports mobile adaptation, offers complete frontend architecture and component library, includes i18n thin version with optimized bundle size under 350KB, and provides comprehensive documentation, video tutorials, Docker support, and Gitpod integration.

repos.description: CAT 作为服务端项目基础组件，提供了 Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go 等多语言客户端，已经在美团点评的基础架构中间件框架（MVC框架，RPC框架，数据库框架，缓存框架等，消息队列，配置系统等）深度集成，为美团点评各业务线提供系统丰富的性能指标、健康状况、实时告警等。
repos.summary_zh: CAT 是美团点评开源的实时应用监控平台，支持 Java、C/C++、Node.js、Python、Go 等多语言客户端，提供 Transaction、Event、Heartbeat、Metric 四种监控模型。其核心优势在于秒级实时数据处理、全量数据采集、高可用部署及高吞吐扩展能力，广泛应用于服务端性能监控、故障定位与业务优化。
repos.summary_en: CAT is a real-time application monitoring platform developed by Meituan-Dianping, offering multi-language clients (Java, C/C++, Node.js, Python, Go) and supporting four monitoring models: Transaction, Event, Heartbeat, and Metric. It excels in sub-minute real-time processing, full-data collection, high availability, and scalable distributed deployment, enabling comprehensive performance tracking, fault detection, and system optimization across enterprise infrastructure.

repos.description: Mobile UI Components based on Vue & WeUI
repos.summary_zh: Vux 是基于 Vue 2.3+ 和 WeUI 构建的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的微信风格组件与交互效果。支持 webpack 构建，集成数据绑定与事件处理，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用，兼容主流移动浏览器。
repos.summary_en: Vux is a mobile UI component library built on Vue 2.3+ and WeUI, offering rich WeChat-style components and interactions. It supports webpack build, data binding, and event handling, ideal for rapid mobile web app development with broad browser compatibility.

repos.description: Mobile UI elements for Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: Mint UI 是一个专为 Vue 2.0 设计的移动端 UI 组件库，提供丰富的移动端常用组件，支持全局注册和按需引入，具备轻量、模块化、易集成的特点，适用于快速开发移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Mint UI is a mobile-first UI component library for Vue 2.0, offering a suite of mobile-optimized components. It supports global registration and modular imports, with features like lightweight design, modularity, and easy integration, ideal for rapid mobile web development.

repos.description: Material design for AngularJS
repos.summary_zh: AngularJS Material 是 Google Material Design 规范在 AngularJS (v1.x) 中的官方实现，提供轻量级、可复用的 UI 组件库，支持响应式布局和无障碍访问。项目已于2022年终止维护，推荐迁移至 Angular Material (v2+) 版本。
repos.summary_en: AngularJS Material is the official implementation of Google's Material Design specification for AngularJS (v1.x), offering a lightweight set of reusable, accessible UI components. Support ended in January 2022; users are advised to migrate to Angular Material (v2+).

repos.description: Themes for Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: Bootswatch 提供一系列开源的 Bootstrap 主题，支持通过预编译 CSS、CDN、Sass 导入、npm 包或 Ruby Gem 集成到项目中，适用于快速美化网页界面，支持主题定制与变量覆盖。
repos.summary_en: Bootswatch offers a collection of open-source themes for Bootstrap, enabling easy integration via pre-compiled CSS, CDN, Sass imports, npm packages, or Ruby Gem. It supports theme customization and variable overrides for rapid UI enhancement.

repos.description: PLEASE READ THE PROJECT STATUS BELOW.  Native AngularJS (Angular) directives for Bootstrap. Smaller footprint (20kB gzipped), no 3rd party JS dependencies (jQuery, bootstrap JS) required. Please read the README.md file before submitting an issue!
repos.summary_zh: UI Bootstrap 是专为 AngularJS 设计的原生指令库，提供 Bootstrap 组件的轻量实现（仅20kB gzipped），无需依赖 jQuery 或 Bootstrap 的 JavaScript。项目已停止维护，推荐迁移至 ng-bootstrap 以支持 Angular 2+。核心优势包括模块化构建、与 AngularJS 深度集成及完善的动画支持。
repos.summary_en: UI Bootstrap provides native AngularJS directives for Bootstrap components with a minimal footprint (20kB gzipped), requiring no jQuery or Bootstrap JS dependencies. The project is now feature-complete and unmaintained, with migration to ng-bootstrap recommended for Angular 2+ users. Key features include modular builds, deep AngularJS integration, and ngAnimate support.

repos.description: ✍ WeChat Markdown Editor | 一款高度简洁的微信 Markdown 编辑器：支持 Markdown 语法、自定义主题样式、内容管理、多图床、AI 助手等特性
repos.summary_zh: Doocs MD 是一款专为微信设计的简洁 Markdown 编辑器，支持完整 Markdown 语法、数学公式、Mermaid 图表、PlantUML 和 Ruby 注音，集成多图床上传与主流 AI 助手，提供自定义主题与本地草稿管理，实现 Markdown 内容一键渲染为美观微信图文。
repos.summary_en: Doocs MD is a minimalist Markdown editor tailored for WeChat, supporting full Markdown syntax, math formulas, Mermaid charts, PlantUML, Ruby annotations, multi-image hosting, and AI assistants. It enables instant rendering of Markdown into visually appealing WeChat articles with customizable themes and local draft management.

repos.description: Essential UI blocks for building mobile web apps.
repos.summary_zh: Ant Design Mobile 是构建移动端 Web 应用的核心 UI 组件库，提供高性能、可定制的原子化组件，支持 CSS 变量主题定制与流畅动画，适用于快速开发跨平台移动应用。
repos.summary_en: Ant Design Mobile is a core UI component library for building mobile web apps, offering high-performance, customizable atomic components with CSS variable theming and smooth animations for cross-platform mobile development.

repos.description: An extended table for integration with some of the most widely used CSS frameworks. (Supports Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, Material Design, Foundation, Vue.js)
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Table 是一个功能强大的表格扩展插件，支持 Bootstrap、Semantic UI、Bulma、Material Design 等主流 CSS 框架。提供排序、分页、筛选、多选、卡片视图、详情视图等丰富功能，支持 AJAX 数据加载、本地化和扩展机制，适用于数据展示与交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Table is a feature-rich table extension for popular CSS frameworks like Bootstrap, Semantic UI, Bulma, and Material Design. It offers sorting, pagination, filtering, row selection, card/detail views, AJAX data loading, localization, and extensibility, making it ideal for dynamic data presentation and interaction.

repos.description: Vira Theme is the official successor of the popular Material Theme. This premium version is actively maintained, includes hand-curated icons and more features
repos.summary_zh: Vira Theme 是广受欢迎的 Material Theme 的官方继任者，提供精心设计的图标和丰富功能。该仓库为 Vira Software 的公共资源库，包含主题资产及设计工具相关素材，支持设计系统一致性与高效开发。
repos.summary_en: Vira Theme is the official successor to the popular Material Theme, offering curated icons and enhanced features. This repository hosts public assets for Vira Software, including theme resources and design tools, supporting consistent design systems and efficient development.

repos.description: This is a Next.js, Tailwind CSS blogging starter template. Comes out of the box configured with the latest technologies to make technical writing a breeze. Easily configurable and customizable. Perfect as a replacement to existing Jekyll and Hugo individual blogs.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个功能强大的 Next.js + Tailwind CSS 博客模板，基于 App Router 和 React Server Components，集成 Contentlayer 管理 Markdown 内容。开箱即用，支持高度可定制，适合替代 Jekyll 和 Hugo 个人博客，提供现代化的技术写作体验。
repos.summary_en: A feature-rich Next.js and Tailwind CSS blogging starter template based on the App Router and React Server Components, using Contentlayer for markdown content management. Fully configured out-of-the-box, highly customizable, and ideal for replacing Jekyll and Hugo personal blogs with modern technical writing capabilities.

repos.description: 丰富多样的 Web 弹出层组件，可轻松实现 Alert/Confirm/Prompt/ 普通提示/页面区块/iframe/tips等等几乎所有的弹出交互。目前已成为最多人使用的弹层解决方案
repos.summary_zh: layer 是一款功能全面的 Web 弹出层组件，支持 Alert、Confirm、Prompt、提示框、页面区块、iframe 等多种交互模式，兼容 IE6+ 及主流浏览器。现已集成至 Layui 框架，提供高性能、易定制的弹层解决方案，广泛应用于企业级 Web 项目，是开发者首选的轻量级交互组件。
repos.summary_en: Layer is a comprehensive web modal component supporting Alert, Confirm, Prompt, tips, iframe, and more. It offers high performance, cross-browser compatibility (including IE6), and extensive customization. Now fully integrated into Layui, it serves as a lightweight, developer-friendly solution for rich user interactions across millions of web platforms.

repos.description: Apple's Liquid Glass effect for React
repos.summary_zh: Liquid Glass React 是一款为 React 应用打造的 Apple 液态玻璃特效组件库，完美复现 macOS 和 iOS 中的毛玻璃视觉效果。支持多模式折射、弹性交互、鼠标追踪位移、色差调节等高级特性，适用于现代 UI 设计中的卡片、按钮等组件，显著提升视觉质感与交互体验。
repos.summary_en: Liquid Glass React is a React component library that replicates Apple's Liquid Glass effect, delivering authentic frosted glass visuals with displacement, refraction, and elastic interactions. It supports multiple refraction modes, mouse tracking, chromatic aberration, and customizable blur/saturation, ideal for modern UI elements like cards and buttons.

repos.description: A Flutter UI Kit（一个 Flutter UI组件库），包含 ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, WaterMark, GradientCircularProgressIndicator...
repos.summary_zh: Flukit 是一个功能丰富的 Flutter UI 组件库，提供 ScaleView、Swiper、PullRefresh、WaterMark 等实用 Widget，涵盖手势交互、动画效果、进度指示器等场景，支持自定义渐变按钮、弹性滚动头部等高级功能，显著提升 Flutter 开发效率。
repos.summary_en: Flukit is a comprehensive Flutter UI kit offering essential widgets like ScaleView, Swiper, PullRefresh, and WaterMark. It supports advanced features such as gesture interactions, gradient animations, elastic headers, and progress indicators, significantly enhancing Flutter app development efficiency.

repos.description: Collection of material design libs and res.
repos.summary_zh: Awesome-MaterialDesign 是一个精选的 Android Material Design 资源与库集合，涵盖官方文档、Google 示例项目、设计资源及第三方开源库，为开发者提供从设计规范到 UI 组件实现的完整解决方案，助力快速构建符合 Material Design 标准的 Android 应用。
repos.summary_en: Awesome-MaterialDesign is a curated collection of Android Material Design resources and libraries, including official docs, Google sample projects, design assets, and third-party open-source libraries, providing a complete solution for developers to build Material Design-compliant Android apps efficiently.

repos.description: The open source Trello alternative.
repos.summary_zh: Kan是一个开源的Trello替代方案，采用Next.js与tRPC技术栈构建，支持看板权限控制、团队协作者邀请、Trello一键导入、标签筛选、活动日志追踪及自定义模板等功能，提供Railway一键部署与Docker Compose自托管两种方案，适合中小团队进行轻量级项目管理与任务协作。
repos.summary_en: Kan is an open-source Trello alternative built with Next.js and tRPC, offering board visibility control, team collaboration, Trello imports, labels, activity logs, and templates. Supports Railway one-click deployment and Docker self-hosting, ideal for small to medium teams seeking lightweight project management and task collaboration.

repos.description: A jQuery UI theme based on Twitter Bootstrap
repos.summary_zh: jQuery UI Bootstrap 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 设计的 jQuery UI 主题，旨在让 jQuery UI 组件与 Bootstrap 风格无缝融合。它支持与 Bootstrap 共存，并提供现代化外观，同时兼容 jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3 及现代浏览器。项目处于活跃开发中，目标是实现 Bootstrap 3.x 兼容性，欢迎社区贡献。
repos.summary_en: jQuery UI Bootstrap is a theme for jQuery UI widgets inspired by Twitter Bootstrap's design, enabling visual consistency between Bootstrap and jQuery UI components. It supports coexistence with Bootstrap CSS and targets jQuery UI 1.9.2/1.10.3. The project is actively developed with goals to achieve Bootstrap 3.x compatibility and welcomes contributors.

repos.description: Wrappers for JavaScript alert(), confirm() and other flexible dialogs using Twitter's bootstrap framework
repos.summary_zh: Bootbox 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap 框架的 JavaScript 对话框封装库，提供简洁易用的 alert()、confirm() 等弹窗接口，支持高度定制化与响应式设计，适用于现代 Web 应用的用户交互场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootbox is a JavaScript library that wraps native alert(), confirm(), and other dialog functions using Twitter's Bootstrap framework, offering customizable, responsive modal dialogs for modern web applications.

repos.description: Drop-in replacement of Django admin comes with lots of goodies, fully extensible with plugin support, pretty UI based on Twitter Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: xadmin 是 Django 管理后台的现代化替代方案，基于 Twitter Bootstrap 提供美观 UI，支持插件扩展、数据导出（XLS/CSV/XML/JSON）、仪表盘、书签等功能，兼容 Django 1.9+，适合快速构建企业级后台管理系统。
repos.summary_en: xadmin is a modern drop-in replacement for Django admin with a Bootstrap-based UI, extensible plugin system, data export (XLS/CSV/XML/JSON), dashboard widgets, and bookmarking. Compatible with Django 1.9+, ideal for building enterprise-grade admin interfaces.

repos.description: Bootstrap components built with Vue.js
repos.summary_zh: VueStrap 是一个基于 Vue.js 和 Bootstrap 3 构建的原生组件库，提供无需 jQuery 依赖的轻量级 UI 解决方案。现已停止维护，推荐使用功能更完善的替代方案 BootstrapVue 或 uiv。
repos.summary_en: VueStrap is a native Vue.js component library built on Bootstrap 3, offering jQuery-free UI components. It is no longer maintained; users are advised to migrate to BootstrapVue or uiv for enhanced features and accessibility.

repos.description: Lightweight CSS framework
repos.summary_zh: MUI 是一个轻量级 CSS 框架，严格遵循 Google 的 Material Design 设计规范，提供响应式网格系统、无依赖组件和邮件样式支持，核心优势在于极小的体积（CSS 6.6KB，JS 5.4KB）和高度可定制性，适合快速构建现代化网页界面。
repos.summary_en: MUI is a lightweight CSS framework adhering to Google's Material Design guidelines, offering a responsive grid, zero dependencies, customizable styling, and email support. Key strengths include minimal footprint (6.6KB CSS, 5.4KB JS gzipped) and async JS loading for fast, modern web development.

repos.description: Quick and easy product tours with Twitter Bootstrap Popovers
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tour 是一个基于 Twitter Bootstrap Popovers 的快速易用的产品引导工具，专为构建交互式用户引导流程设计。支持 Bootstrap 2.3.0+ 版本，提供灵活的 API 和丰富的配置选项，适用于提升用户体验和引导新用户。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tour is a quick and easy product tour library built on Twitter Bootstrap Popovers, designed to create interactive onboarding experiences. Compatible with Bootstrap >= 2.3.0, it offers a flexible API and extensive configuration options for guiding users through applications.

repos.description: A lightweight Vue.js UI library with a simple API, inspired by Google's Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Keen UI 是一个轻量级 Vue.js 3 UI 组件库，采用简洁 API 设计，灵感来自 Google Material Design。它专注于交互式 JavaScript 组件，不依赖 CSS 框架，支持自定义主题与尺寸，并提供独立组件打包方案以优化体积。
repos.summary_en: Keen UI is a lightweight Vue.js 3 UI library featuring a simple API inspired by Google's Material Design. It focuses on interactive JavaScript-driven components without bundling CSS frameworks, supports theme and sizing customization, and offers standalone component builds for bundle optimization.

repos.description: Material Design theme for hexo.
repos.summary_zh: Material Theme 是一款专为 Hexo 博客框架设计的纯净 Material Design 风格主题，支持响应式布局和现代化 UI 交互。提供多版本下载（稳定版/开发版/历史版），集成 BrowserStack 浏览器兼容测试与 jsDelivr CDN 加速服务，具备完善的文档与社区支持。
repos.summary_en: Material Theme is a pure Material Design theme for Hexo, featuring responsive layouts and modern UI interactions. It offers multiple download versions (stable/canary/historical), integrates BrowserStack for cross-browser testing, and uses jsDelivr CDN for fast asset delivery, backed by comprehensive documentation and community support.

repos.description: Material Design 中文协同翻译 - design.1sters.com
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文协同翻译项目致力于将 Google 官方 Material Design 规范完整翻译为中文，覆盖动画、样式、布局等核心模块，采用 GitHub 协作模式，支持多人参与翻译与校对，最终生成网页和 PDF 文档，助力国内设计师与开发者掌握统一设计语言。
repos.summary_en: This project translates Google's Material Design specification into Chinese collaboratively, covering animation, style, layout, and more. It uses GitHub for open collaboration, enabling translators and reviewers to contribute, with final outputs published as web pages and PDFs to support designers and developers in adopting a unified design language.

repos.description: 做最好的接口管理平台
repos.summary_zh: DOClever 是一款专为中小型团队打造的商业化开源接口管理平台，完全免费并支持内网部署。它提供接口全生命周期管理、可视化调试、Mock 服务、自动化测试、团队协作及多格式导入导出等功能，支持 HTTP/HTTPS 协议及多种参数类型，具备版本控制与快照能力，助力高效开发协作。
repos.summary_en: DOClever is a commercial open-source API management platform, fully free and supportable for on-premise deployment. It offers comprehensive API lifecycle management, visual debugging, Mock services, automated testing, team collaboration, and import/export in multiple formats. Supporting HTTP/HTTPS protocols and various parameter types, it features version control, snapshots, and seamless integration with Postman, Swagger, and RAP.

repos.description: weui for react
repos.summary_zh: React-WeUI 是基于 React 框架封装的 WeUI 组件库，提供与微信原生 UI 风格一致的移动端界面组件，支持 npm 安装与 CDN 引用，具备完善的文档与示例，适用于快速构建移动端 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: React-WeUI is a React-based component library implementing WeUI's native WeChat UI design, enabling rapid development of mobile web interfaces with npm installation, CDN support, and comprehensive documentation.

repos.description: Collection of effects for React: Border beam, Liquid Gooey, Thinking orbs
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供两个 React UI 动效组件库：border-beam 实现流光边框动画，liquid-gooey 提供液态变形与流动特效。适用于现代 Web 应用视觉增强，支持源码热更新、独立 npm 发布与 CI 构建部署。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides two React UI animation libraries: border-beam for glowing border effects and liquid-gooey for morphing blob animations. Built with npm workspaces, supporting hot-reload source editing, independent package publishing, and automated CI deployment for modern web visual enhancement.

repos.description: Material Design for Django
repos.summary_zh: Django Material 是一个为 Django 框架打造的 Material Design 3 组件库，提供完整的 CRUD 和管理界面。它基于 TailwindCSS 和 django-cotton，无需构建步骤即可使用预编译的 CSS/JS，支持响应式、无障碍访问及 SPA 式导航，专为 AI 辅助开发优化，实现快速、现代化的 Django 前端开发。
repos.summary_en: Django Material brings Google's Material Design 3 to Django with full-featured CRUD and admin interfaces. Built on TailwindCSS and django-cotton, it offers zero-build, responsive, accessible components powered by Unpoly.js for seamless navigation. Designed for AI-assisted development, it enables rapid, modern frontend development in Django without React, Vue, or Angular.

repos.description: Bootstrap 3 integration with Django.
repos.summary_zh: django-bootstrap3 是 Bootstrap 3 与 Django 的无缝集成库，提供简洁的模板标签（如 `bootstrap_form`）快速渲染响应式表单。现已进入维护模式，仅修复漏洞，建议新项目使用 Bootstrap 5 及对应包 django-bootstrap5。
repos.summary_en: django-bootstrap3 integrates Bootstrap 3 with Django via easy-to-use template tags like `bootstrap_form` for rapid responsive form rendering. Now in maintenance mode—only security fixes—with recommended migration to django-bootstrap5 for new projects.

repos.description: Simple and complete web UI framework to create web apps with Windows 8 Metro user interface, based on Bootstrap 2.
repos.summary_zh: BootMetro 是一个基于 Bootstrap 2 的 Web UI 框架，专为创建具有 Windows 8 Metro 风格界面的应用而设计，无需依赖 Windows 8 系统。它整合了 HTML5 Boilerplate 和 IcoMoon 图标库，提供 Metro 风格的布局、磁贴、通知、列表视图和翻转视图等组件，适用于企业内部网等现代 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: BootMetro is a web UI framework built on Bootstrap 2, designed to create web apps with the Windows 8 MetroUI style without requiring Windows 8. It integrates HTML5 Boilerplate and IcoMoon icons, offering Metro-styled layouts, tiles, toasts, list views, and flip views, ideal for modern intranet applications.

repos.description: Beautiful  UI components build with vue and ant design
repos.summary_zh: vue-beauty 是一个基于 Vue 和 Ant Design 构建的精美 UI 组件库，提供丰富的常用场景组件，采用组件化开发模式，封装复杂逻辑并提供简洁 API，内置样式优化与 ES 新特性垫片，支持现代浏览器，助力开发者快速构建美观的 Vue 应用。
repos.summary_en: vue-beauty is a beautiful UI component library built with Vue and Ant Design, offering a rich set of components for common scenarios. It follows Vue's component-driven architecture, encapsulates complexity with simple APIs, includes optimized Ant Design styling and ES polyfills, and supports modern browsers to accelerate Vue app development.

repos.description: A clock-style timepicker for Bootstrap (or jQuery). Sorry but no longer maintained.
repos.summary_zh: ClockPicker 是一个基于 Bootstrap 或 jQuery 的类时钟风格时间选择器，提供直观的时钟界面用于时间输入。支持桌面和移动设备，兼容 IE9+，具备自动关闭、12/24小时制切换、回调函数等丰富功能，适用于需要美观时间选择器的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: ClockPicker is a clock-style timepicker built for Bootstrap or jQuery, offering an intuitive analog clock interface for time selection. It supports major browsers including IE9+, works on both desktop and mobile devices, and provides features like autoclose, 12/24-hour modes, and customizable callbacks for enhanced user experience.

repos.description: A Django admin theme using Twitter Bootstrap. It doesn't need any kind of modification on your side, just add it to the installed apps.
repos.summary_zh: django-admin-bootstrapped 是一个为 Django 管理后台提供 Twitter Bootstrap 主题的插件，无需修改现有代码即可集成。它支持 Bootstrap 3 样式渲染、可拖拽排序内联表单、自定义 HTML 注入及 XHTML 兼容，显著提升管理界面的视觉体验与交互性。
repos.summary_en: django-admin-bootstrapped is a Django admin theme powered by Twitter Bootstrap, requiring no code changes—just add it to INSTALLED_APPS. It offers Bootstrap 3 styling, drag-and-drop sortable inlines, custom HTML injection, XHTML compatibility, and enhanced message alerts for a modern admin interface.

repos.description: A beautiful component library based on vue3
repos.summary_zh: Lew UI 是一个基于 Vue3 的美观组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件和开箱即用的样式。它集成了 Tippy.js、Lucide 图标、VueUse 等优质开源库，支持虚拟列表、表单验证等高级功能，文档完善，易于集成，适合快速构建现代化 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: Lew UI is a beautiful Vue3-based component library offering a rich set of UI components with out-of-the-box styling. It integrates high-quality open-source libraries like Tippy.js, Lucide icons, and VueUse, supporting advanced features such as virtual lists and form validation. With comprehensive documentation and easy integration, it's ideal for rapidly building modern web applications.

repos.description: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap.
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Colorpicker 是一个专为 Bootstrap 4 设计的模块化颜色选择插件，支持 jQuery 和 Bootstrap CSS/JS。它提供灵活的颜色选择功能，兼容 v2.x（Bootstrap 3/4）和 v3.x（Bootstrap 4 或无 Bootstrap）版本，适用于网页颜色输入场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Colorpicker is a modular color picker plugin for Bootstrap 4, built with jQuery and optional Bootstrap CSS/JS. It supports v2.x (Bootstrap 3/4) and v3.x (Bootstrap 4 or standalone), offering flexible color selection for web applications. Available via npm, yarn, or direct download.

repos.description: A JQuery validation framework for bootstrap forms.
repos.summary_zh: jqBootstrapValidation 是一个专为 Bootstrap 表单设计的 jQuery 验证框架，支持实时输入验证并在 help-block 元素中显示错误提示，提升表单交互体验。
repos.summary_en: jqBootstrapValidation is a jQuery validation framework designed for Bootstrap forms, providing real-time input validation and displaying error messages in help-block elements to enhance form user experience.

repos.description: Tiny JS library using bootstrap's popovers to help guide your users around your website
repos.summary_zh: Bootstro.js 是一个轻量级 JavaScript 库，利用 Bootstrap 的弹出框（popover）功能，为网站提供用户引导功能。支持 Bootstrap 2 和 3，无需修改代码即可适配，仅需一行变更即可从 Bootstrap 2 升级。支持通过 JS 变量或 AJAX 动态加载引导数据，避免污染 HTML，提升可维护性。
repos.summary_en: Bootstro.js is a lightweight JavaScript library that leverages Bootstrap's popover functionality to guide users through a website. It supports both Bootstrap 2 and 3 with minimal code changes. It enables dynamic slideshow creation via JavaScript variables or AJAX, avoiding HTML pollution and improving maintainability.

repos.description: A news-reading App (MVP+Dagger2+RxJava+Retrofit2+Material Design)
repos.summary_zh: ColorfulNews 是一款基于 MVP 架构的新闻阅读应用，采用 Material Design 风格，集成 Dagger2、RxJava 和 Retrofit2 实现高效的数据绑定与网络请求。支持多频道浏览、图片新闻展示及流畅交互体验，适用于 Android 平台学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: ColorfulNews is a news-reading app built with MVP architecture and Material Design, utilizing Dagger2, RxJava, and Retrofit2 for robust dependency injection, reactive programming, and network communication. It supports multi-channel browsing, image news display, and smooth user interactions, ideal for Android development learning.

repos.description: Material Design 中文版 ( 2015 年 8 月更新)
repos.summary_zh: Material Design 中文版是 Google 官方设计规范的首个完整中文翻译项目，由 1sters 团队联合极客学院于 2015 年 8 月完成全面更新。该项目系统性地将 Material Design 核心理念、组件规范与交互原则转化为高质量中文文档，覆盖 60+ 章节，极大推动了中国开发者对现代移动 UI 设计的理解与实践。
repos.summary_en: Material Design 中文版 is the first complete Chinese translation of Google's official design specification, collaboratively completed by the 1sters team and Geekbang Academy in August 2015. This project systematically translates core concepts, component specifications, and interaction principles of Material Design into high-quality documentation, covering over 60 chapters, significantly advancing the understanding and practice of modern mobile UI design among Chinese developers.

repos.description: A simple yet powerful JQuery star rating plugin with fractional rating support.
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap-star-rating 是一款基于 jQuery 的 Bootstrap 星级评分插件，支持分数评级、RTL 方向及纯 CSS3 矢量图标渲染。它可自动将输入框转换为评分控件，兼容 Bootstrap 3/4/5，并支持 FontAwesome 等字体图标库，适用于需要灵活星级评分功能的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap-star-rating is a jQuery plugin for Bootstrap that enables star rating controls with fractional support, RTL compatibility, and pure CSS3 styling. It auto-converts inputs marked with class 'rating', supports Bootstrap 3/4/5, and integrates with font icon libraries like FontAwesome for scalable vector star symbols.

repos.description: Twitter Bootstrap with Metro style
repos.summary_zh: metro-bootstrap 是基于 Twitter Bootstrap 的 Metro 风格主题，提供现代化的扁平化界面设计，支持通过 npm、Git 或 CDN 快速集成，包含预编译 CSS 和 FontAwesome 字体，适用于快速构建 Windows Metro 风格网页应用。
repos.summary_en: metro-bootstrap is a Metro-styled theme built on Twitter Bootstrap, offering a modern flat UI design. It supports easy integration via npm, Git clone, or CDN, includes precompiled CSS and FontAwesome fonts, ideal for quickly building Windows Metro-style web applications.

repos.description: ✨❤️‍🔥Turn the cities you love into stunning designs
repos.summary_zh: MapPoster Online 是一款基于浏览器的地图海报生成工具，可将任意城市地图转化为精美的艺术海报。作为 Python CLI 工具的 Web 升级版，它无需安装，开箱即用。项目采用 React 19 与 TypeScript 构建前端，利用 Rust 编译为 WebAssembly 实现高性能图像处理，结合 Tailwind CSS 打造现代化 UI，支持全球主要城市的地图风格化设计。
repos.summary_en: MapPoster Online is a browser-based map poster generator that transforms city maps into stunning artistic designs. As a web upgrade to the Python CLI tool, it requires no installation and is ready to use instantly. Built with React 19 and TypeScript, it leverages Rust compiled to WebAssembly for high-performance image processing, paired with Tailwind CSS for a modern UI, supporting stylized map designs for major global cities.

repos.description: A Gorgeous LoadingView (一个绚丽的LoadingView )
repos.summary_zh: GADownloading 是一个绚丽的自定义 Android LoadingView，无需图片资源，通过代码实现动态加载动画。支持成功/失败状态切换，提供丰富的自定义属性（颜色、线条、文本等），可自动调整尺寸。适用于下载进度展示，兼容 JitPack 集成与源码复制两种接入方式，强调纯代码实现与高度可定制性。
repos.summary_en: GADownloading is a visually stunning custom Android LoadingView that renders animations purely through code without image resources. It supports dynamic progress updates, success/failure states, and extensive customization via XML attributes. Designed for download progress indication, it offers JitPack integration or direct source copying, emphasizing code-only implementation and high configurability.

repos.description: 此项目已停止维护，建议迁移到  https://github.com/museui/muse-ui/
repos.summary_zh: vue-carbon 是基于 Vue.js 1.0 开发的 Material Design 风格移动端 Web UI 库，提供丰富的组件如 Refresh Control、HeaderBar 等，支持 npm 安装与 webpack 集成，现已停止维护，推荐迁移至 Muse UI。
repos.summary_en: Vue-carbon is a Material Design style mobile web UI library built with Vue.js 1.0, featuring components like Refresh Control and HeaderBar. It supports npm installation and webpack integration but is no longer maintained; migration to Muse UI is recommended.

repos.description: A jQuery tag/token input plugin for Twitter's Bootstrap, by the guys from Sliptree
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tokenfield 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签输入插件，支持键盘操作、复制粘贴、自动补全集成等功能。虽然项目已停止维护，但仍可用于需要轻量级标签输入的场景，尤其适合与 Bootstrap 3+ 和 jQuery 1.9+ 配合使用。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tokenfield is a jQuery plugin for tag/token input built on Twitter Bootstrap, supporting keyboard navigation, copy-paste, and integration with autocomplete/typeahead. Though unmaintained, it remains useful for lightweight tagging in Bootstrap 3+ environments with jQuery 1.9+.

repos.description: Bootstrap alert system made better, builds off of bootstrap-alert.js
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap-notify 是对 Bootstrap 原生警告系统的增强扩展，基于 bootstrap-alert.js 构建，提供更丰富的通知样式与交互能力，适用于现代 Web 应用中的用户提示与消息展示。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Notify enhances the native Bootstrap alert system by building on bootstrap-alert.js, offering improved notification styles and interactions for modern web applications.

repos.summary_zh: 本仓库提供 Android Design Support Library 的完整教程，包含60分钟实战项目，涵盖 Snackbar、FloatingActionButton、NavigationView 等核心组件的集成与交互实现，适合 Android 开发者学习现代 UI 设计模式。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers a comprehensive 60-minute codelab tutorial on the Android Design Support Library, demonstrating integration of key UI components like Snackbar, FloatingActionButton, and NavigationView to build modern Android interfaces with Material Design principles.

repos.description: Bootstrap-themed jquery tag interface
repos.summary_zh: Bootstrap Tags 是一个 jQuery 插件，用于扩展 Twitter Bootstrap 的标签功能，支持 Bootstrap 2.3.2 和 3+ 版本。它提供自动建议、排除/过滤列表、占位符提示、Bootstrap 按钮样式集成以及可自定义的扩展点，适用于需要交互式标签输入的 Web 表单场景。
repos.summary_en: Bootstrap Tags is a jQuery plugin that extends Twitter Bootstrap with tagging functionality, supporting Bootstrap 2.3.2 and 3+. It features autosuggest, exclusion/filtering, popovers, placeholder prompts, and Bootstrap button styling, making it ideal for interactive tag-based input in web forms.

repos.description: 针对 Vue 框架移植的 We UI 框架的适配，让 mobile开发过程成为一种享受。 Demo:
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是将 WeUI 移动端 UI 框架适配到 Vue.js 的项目，结合 vue-router、ES6 和 Webpack 构建现代化移动应用开发环境，提供开箱即用的组件库和开发工具链，显著提升移动端开发效率与体验。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a Vue.js adaptation of the WeUI mobile UI framework, integrating vue-router, ES6, and Webpack to deliver a modern development stack for mobile apps. It offers ready-to-use components and tooling to streamline mobile development.

repos.description: 🥘Base on element-ui, makes crud easily
repos.summary_zh: el-data-table 是基于 element-ui 封装的 CRUD 表格组件，支持自动请求、分页、树形数据、自定义搜索和操作列，集成 @femessage/el-form-renderer 渲染表单，通过配置化实现快速开发 RESTful API 管理界面。
repos.summary_en: el-data-table is a CRUD table component built on element-ui, featuring auto data fetching via axios, pagination, tree structures, custom search, and operation columns. It uses @femessage/el-form-renderer for form rendering and supports configuration-driven RESTful API management.

repos.description: 基于avalon的组件库
repos.summary_zh: avalon.oniui 是去哪儿网前端团队基于 Avalon 1.4 开发的 UI 组件库，提供丰富的 UI 组件（如表格、弹窗、分页）和功能性组件（如拖拽、定位、快捷键），覆盖表单、交互、数据展示等场景，支持模块化调用与扩展。
repos.summary_en: avalon.oniui is a UI component library developed by Qunar's frontend team, built on Avalon 1.4. It offers a comprehensive set of UI components (e.g., grids, dialogs, pagination) and utility modules (e.g., drag-and-drop, positioning, hotkeys), enabling modular integration for web applications with rich interactivity and data presentation.

repos.description: Native AngularJS colorpicker directive. No dependency on jQuery or jQuery plugin is required.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个原生 AngularJS 颜色选择器指令，基于 bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery 库开发，无需依赖 jQuery。支持 Hex、RGB、RGBA 格式，可自定义位置、尺寸和事件，适用于 Bootstrap v3.x.x 项目，提供灵活的配置选项和丰富的交互事件。
repos.summary_en: A native AngularJS color picker directive based on bootstrap-colorpicker jQuery library, with no jQuery dependency. Supports Hex, RGB, RGBA formats, customizable positioning, sizing, and events. Ideal for Bootstrap v3.x.x projects with flexible configuration and rich interaction events.

repos.description: (Deprecated) WeUI Components with love of vue.js
repos.summary_zh: vue-weui 是一个已停止维护的 Vue 组件库，封装了 WeUI 0.4.0+ 的微信风格 UI 组件，完全解耦 CSS 样式，支持按需引入以优化包体积，适用于移动端 Web 应用开发。
repos.summary_en: vue-weui is a deprecated Vue component library that encapsulates WeUI 0.4.0+ components for WeChat Web apps. It decouples CSS for full customization and supports selective imports to minimize bundle size.

repos.description: [Unmaintained] An easy to use material design based framework.
repos.summary_zh: Material Framework 是一个轻量级、纯 CSS 实现的 Material Design 前端框架，提供完整的组件样式与响应式布局支持，适用于快速构建现代化网页应用，依赖 Google Material Design 图标与自定义配色方案。
repos.summary_en: Material Framework is a lightweight, CSS-only implementation of Material Design, offering complete component styling and responsive layouts for rapid development of modern web applications, leveraging Google's Material Design Icons and custom color schemes.

repos.description: a simple but powerful tool for validating form fields.  support bootstrap and your own styles.
repos.summary_zh: SMValidator 是一个轻量、无依赖的前端表单验证工具，支持通过 HTML 属性或 JavaScript 配置验证规则，兼容 Bootstrap 和 Semantic UI 样式，支持正则表达式和自定义函数验证，兼容 IE8+，提供灵活的错误提示与样式定制能力。
repos.summary_en: SMValidator is a lightweight, dependency-free form validation tool that supports rule configuration via HTML attributes or JavaScript. It integrates with Bootstrap and Semantic UI, supports RegExp and custom function validation, and is compatible with IE8+, offering flexible error messaging and styling options.

repos.description: A declarative, SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in Swift.
repos.summary_zh: TUIkit 是一个 SwiftUI 风格的终端用户界面框架，提供纯 Swift 实现的声明式 TUI 开发体验。支持状态管理、布局容器、交互组件和完整样式系统，无需 ncurses 或 C 依赖，适用于 macOS 和 Linux 平台。
repos.summary_en: TUIkit is a SwiftUI-like framework for building Terminal User Interfaces in pure Swift, offering declarative syntax with state management, layout containers, interactive components, and full styling support without ncurses or C dependencies.

repos.description: Android Client for Carbon Forum with Material Design.
repos.summary_zh: Android-Carbon-Forum 是一个基于 Material Design 的 Carbon Forum 论坛 Android 客户端，提供流畅的移动端浏览体验，支持主题查看、发帖、登录、通知推送等功能，采用模块化架构便于二次开发和定制部署。
repos.summary_en: Android-Carbon-Forum is an Android client for Carbon Forum built with Material Design, offering seamless mobile browsing, topic viewing, posting, login, and push notifications. It features a modular architecture for easy customization and deployment.

repos.description: Django template tag for rendering Page objects as Bootstrap pagination HTML
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供 Django 模板标签，用于将 Django 的 Page 对象渲染为兼容 Bootstrap 的分页 HTML。支持 Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x 版本，提供灵活的配置选项如页码范围、前后跳转链接等，适用于 Django 1.2+ 项目，现已归档不再维护。
repos.summary_en: This Django template tag renders Page objects into Bootstrap-compatible pagination HTML. It supports Bootstrap 2.x/3.x/4.x, offers configurable options like page ranges and prev/next links, and is compatible with Django 1.2+. The project is now archived and no longer maintained.

repos.description: It is a materializecss.com implementation with Vue.js.
repos.summary_zh: material-ui-vue 是一个基于 Vue.js 的 MaterializeCSS 组件库实现，提供 Material Design 风格的 UI 组件封装。支持通过 npm 安装，需配合 MaterializeCSS 资源文件使用，适用于快速构建现代化前端界面，但当前版本为试验性质，稳定性未经验证。
repos.summary_en: material-ui-vue is a Vue.js implementation of MaterializeCSS, offering Material Design UI components. It can be installed via npm and requires MaterializeCSS assets including CSS, JS, and jQuery. Designed for rapid development of modern web interfaces, though marked as unstable and not recommended for production use.

repos.description: A jquery and bootstrap basic tree view plugin, easily use.
repos.summary_zh: EasyTree 是一个基于 jQuery 和 Bootstrap 3 的轻量级树形视图插件，可将无序列表快速转换为支持选择、添加、编辑和删除操作的交互式树形结构，适用于需要动态层级数据管理的 Web 应用。
repos.summary_en: EasyTree is a lightweight jQuery and Bootstrap 3-based plugin that transforms unordered lists into interactive tree views with selectable, addable, editable, and deletable nodes, ideal for dynamic hierarchical data management in web applications.

repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 Django 项目提供基于 Bootstrap 3 的日期时间选择器组件，集成 Eonasdan 的 bootstrap-datetimepicker 插件，支持通过 moment.js 进行灵活的时间格式化，适用于表单中的日期和 datetime 字段输入，自动适配当前语言环境。
repos.summary_en: This Django package integrates the Bootstrap 3 datetimepicker widget (v2) by Eonasdan, enabling date and datetime field inputs in forms with moment.js-based formatting. It auto-detects the current language and requires Bootstrap 3 and jQuery. Compatible with Django 1.3+ and Python 2.4+.

repos.description: weui sketch by ZTfer
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供微信官方 WeUI 设计框架的 Sketch 源文件，包含完整 UI 组件库（按钮、单元格、弹窗、进度条等），尺寸与色彩严格遵循 WeUI 规范，支持 750*1334 设计稿尺寸，配套字体与@0.5x/@2x 效果图，助力设计师高效产出符合微信原生体验的界面。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides Sketch source files for WeUI, a UI framework by WeChat. It includes fully designed components (buttons, cells, dialogs, progress bars, etc.) with exact adherence to WeUI's design specs, supporting 750*1334 layout, bundled with @0.5x/@2x preview images and system fonts for rapid prototyping.

repos.description: bootstrap3 validation
repos.summary_zh: bootstrap3-validation.js 是一个专为 Bootstrap 3 设计的 jQuery 表单验证插件，支持多种内置校验规则（如邮箱、URL、日期、数字等），支持自定义校验逻辑和异步验证，兼容 IE8，提供简洁的 HTML 属性配置方式，适用于水平表单和内联表单样式。
repos.summary_en: bootstrap3-validation.js is a jQuery plugin designed for Bootstrap 3 form validation, supporting built-in rules (e.g., email, URL, date, number), custom validation logic, asynchronous checks, IE8 compatibility, and clean HTML attribute-based configuration for horizontal and inline forms.

repos.description: v2ex 的 Material design 风格 CSS
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库为 V2EX 论坛提供 Material Design 风格的自定义 CSS 主题，通过注入样式实现现代化视觉升级，支持 Chrome 浏览器，用户可通过自定义 CSS 功能一键应用，显著提升界面美观度与用户体验。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a Material Design-styled CSS theme for V2EX forum, enabling a modern visual upgrade through custom CSS injection. It supports Chrome browsers and allows users to apply the theme instantly via the custom CSS setting, enhancing UI aesthetics and user experience.
